events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Gordon Sumner, known as Sting, the iconic frontman of The Police and successful solo artist, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Sting's legacy
angles.copy: From The Police to a prolific solo career, Sting has consistently delivered incredible music. What's your all-time favourite track?

events.title: Original iPod released 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple launched the first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music and paving the way for digital music players.

angles.name: Music in your pocket
angles.copy: 25 years since the original iPod dropped. Remember the click wheel? It changed everything for music on the go.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, an annual celebration of the iconic 007 film franchise, commemorating the release of 'Dr. No' in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Which 007 theme song gets your vote as the absolute best?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles' legendary co-founder, John Lennon, born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent and enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music still resonates globally.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, famous for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy icon
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel mayhem, his comedic genius is timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, universally known as 'The White Album,' was released on November 22, 1968, showcasing the band's diverse musical directions.

angles.name: Iconic White Album
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped the iconic 'White Album'. Which track from this sprawling masterpiece is your go-to?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Legendary Showman
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul milestone
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A true classic that pushed boundaries. Which track stands out for you?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: Remembering a legend
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, we lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we pay tribute to the visionary artist David Bowie, born on January 8, 1947.

angles.name: Remembering the Starman
angles.copy: Celebrating the extraordinary life and music of David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. A true innovator.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 92nd birthday of the 'King of Rock and Roll,' Elvis Presley, born on January 8, 1935.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we honour the legendary Elvis Presley. His impact on music is immeasurable.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: The iconic Led Zeppelin guitarist and songwriter, Jimmy Page, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! His riffs defined a generation. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the distinctive-voiced British rock and pop singer, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Maggie May and more
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! A career filled with incredible hits. What's your top Rod track?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of the legendary band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness frontman
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the voice of Madness! From Camden Town to global hits, his energy is infectious.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The smooth-voiced British singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' and 'Every Time You Go Away,' celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Blue-eyed soul legend
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! His incredible voice gave us some unforgettable 80s classics. What's your favourite?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music icon, singer-songwriter, and businesswoman Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true icon whose music and spirit shine bright. What's your favourite Dolly hit?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman, singer-songwriter, and producer Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That leader
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That to solo success, he's given us so many anthems. What's your favourite?
